labels.io.gravitee.description: Sets up the playground with its own entrypoint
labels.io.gravitee.name: Playground seed

files.compose.yml:
x-gravitee: {kind: playground, name: Seeder with its own entrypoint, category: Other, description: Runs the seeder's folder with a command of its own}
services:
  hostile-n01-entrypoint-seed:
    image: hostile-seeder
    build: ../../../../../seeder
    pull_policy: build
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c", "python /seed/seed.py"]
    labels:
      io.gravitee.role: seed
      io.gravitee.name: Playground seed
      io.gravitee.description: Sets up the playground with its own entrypoint
    volumes:
      - ./seed:/seed:ro
    environment:
      APIM_MANAGEMENT_URL: http://apim-management-api:8083
      APIM_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8082
      HOSTILE_DEMO_PASSWORD: ${HOSTILE_DEMO_PASSWORD:-demo}

meta.description: Runs the seeder's folder with a command of its own
meta.name: Seeder with its own entrypoint
